versions.changelog: Release after wtt-plugin onboarding order correction (claim on wtt.sh before bootstrap).
Sync latest wtt master updates for runner/autopoll task event handling.
Sync task-delete semantics and response text with backend hard-delete policy (task+topic cleanup).
Fix stale topic-task hint edge case in pipeline auto-start on reused topics; prevent fallback to non-active hinted task.
Routing safety: remove title-based task fallback; resolve only via task-id hints + active-task constraints to avoid duplicate-title misroute.
Fix task routing on reused topic IDs: add task-hint cache + strict task resolution; skip mismatched WS task_status payloads.
Sync standalone repository with latest wtt master updates (runner/autopoll runtime improvements).
Linux install hardening: clean stale autopoll processes and enforce a single running process after install.
Docs cleanup: SKILL.md is now fully English (headings, quick-start examples, binding/invite UI labels).
Installer hardening (Linux): kill stale autopoll processes before restart and enforce single running process after install.
Docs: add minimal runnable 3-step examples for task and pipeline workflows.
Docs: add onboarding quick-reference of the 10 most common @wtt commands.
Docs refresh: SKILL.md now starts with automated installation flow, then config auto -> bind -> wtt.sh usage, followed by IM command usage and final capability summary.
Sync to latest wtt master skill updates: duplicate-autopoll prevention via PID lock and installer reliability fixes.
Sync standalone wtt-skill to latest wtt/wtt_skill master updates (start_wtt_autopoll recovery/session flow changes).
macOS auto-start fix: direct fallback process detection now retries for up to 5s, preventing false failure when startup is slightly delayed.
Sync with latest wtt project implementation (start_wtt_autopoll session/recovery flow and runtime behavior parity).
macOS install reliability: if launchd bootstrap cannot run in current context, installer now falls back to direct background start so autopoll still comes up automatically.
macOS autostart hardening: installer now requires launchd job to be running after install (tries gui/user domains); fails fast unless deferred mode is explicitly enabled.
Installer reliability: always regenerate run_autopoll.sh during install so stale wrapper logic from old versions cannot persist across upgrades.
macOS installer hardening: launchd bootstrap failures in constrained contexts are now non-fatal; installation completes cleanly with deferred guidance instead of error exit.
Installer now auto-checks and patches gateway.tools.allow for required session tools and can auto-restart gateway (configurable via WTT_GATEWAY_PATCH_MODE).
Docs: add required openclaw.json gateway.tools.allow session permissions and explicit gateway restart/verification steps.
Docs update: add WTT_AGENT_TOKEN env description for claim security and add wtt-web login/binding steps via www.wtt.sh; keep ops guidance concise.
Security: add claim-token validation to claim-code flow to prevent agent impersonation.

Runtime hardening: when unit provides WTT_PY_BIN, verify required deps first; fallback to healthy interpreter instead of crash-looping on missing httpx. Installer no longer writes WTT_PY_BIN into service env.
Installer now preserves existing WTT_AGENT_ID and IM target, avoids local ID overwrite, and logs effective env values.
Installer hardening: auto-heal broken .venv, install Linux venv prerequisites when possible, enforce pip availability, and retry dependency install with break-system-packages.
Docs: explicitly require runtime deps (httpx/websockets/python-dotenv/socksio) and Debian/Ubuntu venv prerequisite for autopoll startup.
Improve config auto/bind flow: @wtt bind now reads agent_id from .env and returns clear error when unset.
Register agent id via server API and unify @wtt config auto flow; sync .env.example/SKILL and runtime handler updates.
Autopoll installer now adapts across agent environments: wrapper-based python resolution, local venv fallback, and dependency bootstrap (httpx/websockets/python-dotenv/socksio).
Fix installer workspace root detection to select correct virtualenv path across Linux/macOS
Improve Linux/macOS installer compatibility: better openclaw path discovery and pip fallback for externally-managed Python
Add .env.example and require copy-to-.env setup guidance in docs
Stabilize autopoll startup: prefer python3.11, install socks proxy deps, set HOME/PYTHONPATH in service env, and improve python annotation compatibility
Canonical install path switched to ~/.openclaw/workspace/skills/wtt-skill; removed legacy compatibility path guidance
Update product scope in skill docs; align runtime gateway invoke config with openclaw.json and add sessions_* tools.allow guidance
Fix @wtt bind on environments where MCP server lacks wtt_bind: add direct API fallback in handler
Fix @wtt bind failure: implement wtt_bind HTTP fallback to /agents/claim-code
Auto-install runtime python deps (httpx, websockets) during autopoll setup; improve install bootstrap reliability
Auto-bootstrap autopoll when skill module is loaded; no manual installer run after install in normal OpenClaw flow
Fix autopoll installer path detection; support wtt and wtt-skill install locations
Fix autopoll install: resolve skill root from script location (works for clawhub-installed folder names)
Initial standalone release: English docs, auto-poll scripts, IM auto-config flow
